title: Handwoven Natural Straw Tote Bag | Eco-Friendly Everyday Carry
descriptionHtml:
Handmade Eco-Friendly Straw Tote Bag

Carry the earth's beauty with you. Our handwoven natural straw tote bag is crafted by skilled Indian artisans using sustainably harvested grass — a timeless accessory for the conscious, modern woman.

Why You'll Love It

Lightweight yet durable, this multipurpose tote moves effortlessly from market runs to weekend escapes. Each bag is uniquely woven, meaning no two are exactly alike — yours is truly one of a kind.

Crafted with Purpose

Made using traditional weaving techniques passed down through generations, this bag supports rural artisan communities and champions slow, sustainable fashion. Every purchase preserves a craft and empowers a maker.

Perfect For

Daily shopping, travel, beach days, gifting, and eco-conscious living.

Material & Care

100% natural grass fibers. Keep away from prolonged moisture. Wipe clean with a dry cloth.
